summary: Frontend-only visual regression test for the 'Confirmar Inscrição' button on /confirmacao.html. All computed style assertions passed: background rgb(24,88,191) (#1858BF), color rgb(255,255,255), border 1px solid rgb(24,88,191). Hover state correctly changes to rgb(15,76,173) (#0f4cad) and reverts on mouseout. Sibling 'Alterar Dados' button retains its grey secondary style rgb(224,224,224). Functional smoke click succeeded - the click handler fires (a success modal 'Inscrição realizada com sucesso!' was shown) and no TypeError appeared in console. Only console noise is a benign Cloudflare beacon CSP warning unrelated to this change.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Cloudflare Insights beacon is blocked by the site's CSP (script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' data:). Not caused by this change but worth cleaning up either by removing the beacon or allowing static.cloudflareinsights.com in CSP.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Style fix on /app/frontend/public/confirmacao.html #btn-confirmar verified. Use wait_until='domcontentloaded' and cache-bust the URL - networkidle times out due to Cloudflare beacons. data-testid selectors used: btn-confirmar-inscricao and btn-alterar-dados.
